content.description:
Who We Are & Why Join Us

Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries -- energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics -- accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale.

Cutting-Edge AI Innovation -- Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. High-Growth Environment -- Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm. Meaningful Impact -- Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives.

Learn more at: avathon.com

Senior Enterprise Account Executive – High-Tech

Location: Pleasanton, CA

About the Role

As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive within Avathon’s Go-to-Market organization, you will own full-cycle net-new logo acquisition and strategic account expansion for the Avathon Autonomous Operations Platform. This role is built for a proven enterprise hunter operating at the intersection of Enterprise AI, High-Tech/Semiconductors, and Complex Global Supply Chain Operations.

Working directly alongside the Office of the CEO and senior commercial leadership, you will penetrate Fortune 500 High-Tech OEMs, semiconductor manufacturers, and global electronics leaders—translating complex operational, manufacturing, and supply chain bottlenecks into measurable ROI through Avathon’s Physical AI and autonomy platform.

Responsibilities

Own Full-Cycle Enterprise Sales: Drive net-new ARR from executive outbound prospecting and technical discovery through POC execution, business case development, and complex contract negotiation ($250K–$1M+ ACV).

Penetrate High-Tech & Supply Chain Accounts: Build multi-threaded relationships across the C-suite and operational leadership—including VPs of Supply Chain, COOs, VPs of Manufacturing/Operations, and Heads of AI/Digital Transformation.

Execute Strategic Co-Sell Motions: Leverage Avathon’s established cloud, hyperscaler, and system integrator partnerships to accelerate deal cycles and expand enterprise footprint.

Partner with Executive Leadership: Collaborate directly with the CEO’s office, Solution Architecture, and Product teams to lead executive briefings, shape custom value propositions, and close flagship accounts.

Maintain Operational Rigor: Manage accurate forecasting, deal progression, and account plans in Salesforce using structured enterprise methodologies (MEDDPICC / Challenger).

Qualifications

8+ years of direct, quota-carrying enterprise software (SaaS/AI) closing experience, with demonstrated multi-year tenure (2+ years per role) and a consistent track record of exceeding $1.5M+ annual quotas.

Domain & Ecosystem Pedigree: Strong background selling enterprise AI, supply chain planning/orchestration (e.g., o9, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, E2open), ERP/MES, or cloud infrastructure into High-Tech, Semiconductor, Hardware/OEM, or Advanced Manufacturing accounts.

Enterprise Deal Mastery: Proven ability to navigate 6–12 month, multi-stakeholder buying committees, structure technical pilots/POVs, and quantify operational ROI for C-level buyers.

Builder Mentality: Self-starting hunter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and knows how to build pipeline from scratch without relying solely on inbound leads.

Location & Work Authorization: Must be local to the San Francisco Bay Area (commutable to Pleasanton, CA) and authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

Salary:

$250k-$320k OTE. Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

As part of our hiring process, Avathon conducts professional reference checks focused on sales performance, customer relationship management, quota attainment, and overall sales effectiveness. Candidates should be prepared to provide references who can speak to their sales achievements and approach.

What are the benefits and perks at Avathon?

Our full-time employees and their loved ones will be supported with a competitive and comprehensive benefits package. Below are some highlights we offer to our U.S. full-time employees - we’d love to connect and share more!

Evolving culture with the opportunity to drive new ideas and technology

Stock Option Grants

Generous Time Off Programs

Medical Coverage, and Parental Leave Plans

Employer-Sponsored Lifestyle Spending Account

401k with Employer Match

Monthly Technology Allowance

Contract and temporary roles are not eligible for the above benefits.

Avathon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Avathon is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us to discuss how we can assist you.
